name: pulmonary function tests overview
title: Reading pulmonary function tests in three steps: an FEV1/FVC ratio under 0.7 is obstruction with hyperinflation; otherwise static volumes decide, a total lung capacity under 80% is restriction, and the diffusion capacity then separates parenchymal (reduced) from extraparenchymal (normal) restriction; normal volumes with a low diffusion capacity point to anemia, pulmonary vascular disease or early lung disease

root.title: Dyspnea or cough not yet diagnosed: what do the PULMONARY FUNCTION TESTS (PFTs) show?
lines: read in three steps: SPIROMETRY → static lung VOLUMES → DIFFUSION capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)
do NOT test with: aneurysm · pneumothorax · recent brain or eye surgery · BP > 200/120 · recent heart attack or arrhythmia

groups.title: FEV1/FVC < 0.7: OBSTRUCTION
